messages:
maya_csm: Sharing a compact 'Pause & Stabilize' playbook we used with FinchHealth. Goal: quick mitigation for go-live churn and a fast renewal-safe path.

tony_eng: Can you paste the 5-step call checklist we read out loud? Need to add to the customer-facing playcard.

maya_csm: 5-step quick checklist (1-2 min):
1) Confirm warm_pool >= 6 for first 3 hours.
2) Prefill prefix cache with top 30 recent prefixes.
3) Set stream_fallback_ms = 700.
4) Turn on session affinity header X-Affinity when possible.
5) Enable 24h & 7d feedback webhook.

saira_sre: Note: we consider a tenant 'unstable' after 5 warm_pool misses in 15m. Action: set tenant mode -> pause-streaming, enable batch-summary path, and scale warmpool to 10 if reserved capacity available.

jax_onboard: Minimal client header we share:
```
X-Client-Queue: tenant-<id>
X-Affinity: session-<sid>
X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
Accept: text/event-stream
```

tony_eng: Short emulator we run prelaunch (single line):
`seq 1 150 | xargs -n1 -P8 curl -s -H "X-Client-Queue: tenant-$T" -d '{"prompt":"check"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate &>/dev/null`

maya_csm: Renewal risk rule we used: usage drop >= 30% + p95 latency up >=150ms + 24h feedback <=3 => create priority "pause & stabilize" ticket and schedule a remediation call within 48h.

saira_sre: Monitoring alerts to add to tenant card:
- warmpool_miss_rate > 3% over 10m -> create ticket
- first_token_latency_p50 > 800ms -> mark for streaming fallback
- feedback_24h <=3 -> auto-assign AM

stability-bot: Playbook card created: https://board.redwood.internal/play/20488 tags=[pause-stabilize, warmpool, feedback] :white_check_mark:

maya_csm: I'll add owners and a Day-2 check reminder. Thanks team! :pray:
